headline: Shelf Surges as Expanse, Line and Strand Burn
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition the fighting has shifted from Callahan's Passage to four fronts filing at the wire. The Weathered Expanse counts six changes in two hours to 18:11 for forty-nine on the day, now three Warden, four Colonial and two unheld about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, with twenty-four-hour losses of 6,864 Colonial and 10,779 Warden. The Stlican Shelf adds eight changes in two hours for twenty-four on the day, now one Warden and eight Colonial about Briar, with losses of 3,304 and 3,824. The Nevish Line reports four changes in two hours for twenty-three on the day, now five Warden, one Colonial and two unheld about Blinding Stones, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother, with losses of 2,565 and 2,802. Kuura Strand bursts with all eight of its day's changes in two hours to 17:42 about Martti and Menneen, still six Warden-held, with sharp short-hour casualties. The Passage has gone quiet in two hours, last heard at 16:11 for twenty-nine on the day, now ten Warden-held, while Palantine Berm and Mooring County remain silent since 11:55 and 13:16.
